title: Falcons OC Tommy Rees: We'll have open dialogue about our QB choice

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Falcons OC Tommy Rees: We'll have open dialogue about our QB choice
sources.description: The Falcons' quarterback competition fully launched this week with Michael Penix's clearance for all phases of football work and the team will be under a time crunch to make their choice for Week 1.
